facts.fact: The LughaGen Multilingual Kenyan Language Corpus, built under JHUB Africa (JKUAT) with NVIDIA funding, is published on Hugging Face as a dataset for language modelling in Swahili, Kikuyu, Kamba and Dholuo, with 11.3 million Swahili rows and about 0.85 million rows in the other three languages, partly synthetic.
